mechanism_narrative: Persistently low federal funds rate compresses discount rates for equity cash flows, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over 20 trading days without threshold conditions.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in >60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 0.7%, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate falling below 0.5% signals aggressive monetary easing, boosting equity valuations and producing positive S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in >60% of FEDFUNDS < 0.5% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous non-farm payrolls growth and unemployment decline signal robust labor market conditions, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days through earnings support.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >60% of PAYEMS↑0.5% and UNRATE↓0.2pp periods, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Early housing market recovery phase (rising housing starts) signals consumer confidence rebound, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of early housing recovery periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 during regime.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained industrial production growth indicates expanding manufacturing output, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >60% of INDPRO growth periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and causing negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: 5-day returns are positive in >60% of UNRATE > 5.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent housing starts growth and retail sales expansion signal strong consumer demand, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days through revenue growth.
failure_condition: 20-day returns are negative in >60% of HOUST↑0.5% and RSAFS↑0.5% periods, or interaction Rank IC < 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Disinflationary environment (CPI year-over-year growth < 2.0%) supports accommodative monetary policy, generating positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns are negative in >60% of CPIAUCSL YoY < 2.0% periods, or Rank IC < 0.03 during regime.
